definitions.gloss: being buried; submergence; sinking into the ground
definitions.explanation: The physical state of being buried or submerged under earth, sand, snow, or other material.

definitions.gloss: falling into obscurity; being overlooked; going unnoticed
definitions.explanation: Used figuratively for talent, achievements, or individuals that are buried or overlooked, failing to receive proper recognition.

examples.japanese: {遺跡|いせき}が{砂|すな}に{埋没|まいぼつ}していた。
examples.english: The ruins were buried in sand.

examples.japanese: {噴火|ふんか}で{村|むら}が{埋没|まいぼつ}した。
examples.english: The village was buried by the eruption.

examples.japanese: {土砂崩|どしゃくず}れで{道路|どうろ}が{埋没|まいぼつ}して{通行止|つうこうど}めになった。
examples.english: The road was buried by a landslide and closed to traffic.

examples.japanese: {才能|さいのう}が{埋没|まいぼつ}してしまう。
{歴史|れきし}に{埋没|まいぼつ}した{偉人|いじん}は{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There are many great figures lost to history.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな{組織|そしき}では{個人|こじん}の{意見|いけん}が{埋没|まいぼつ}しがちだ。
examples.english: In large organizations, individual opinions tend to get buried.

notes:
{埋没|まいぼつ} means being buried or submerged, used both literally (under earth, sand) and figuratively (talent or individuals going unrecognized). It is a formal, written-style word.

COMPOUNDS:
{埋|まい} (bury) + {没|ぼつ} (sink, submerge).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {砂|すな}に{埋没|まいぼつ}する: to be buried in sand
- {才能|さいのう}の{埋没|まいぼつ}: wasted/unrecognized talent
- {埋没|まいぼつ}{林|りん}: buried forest
- {埋没|まいぼつ}{費用|ひよう}: sunk cost (economics)
- {埋没|まいぼつ}{法|ほう}: buried suture method (cosmetic surgery)

RELATED WORDS:
- {埋|う}もれる: to be buried (everyday word, less formal)
- {埋|う}める: to bury, to fill in

REGISTER:
A formal, literary word. In everyday speech, {埋|う}もれる is more natural for the physical sense. {埋没|まいぼつ} is preferred in written, academic, or figurative contexts.
